scope: 知识数据与HTTP接口隔离测试；未读写运行库、未调用外部模型

tests.name: private creative memory isolates owners and workspaces and permits a viewer to maintain only their own memory
private creative memory uses exact half-life and expiry boundaries without refreshing confirmation on reads
private creative memory replaces an existing version on explicit confirmation and rejects stale concurrent writes
private creative memory allows pausing an expired temporary record without reconfirming it, and requires a future expiry when enabling it
private creative memory rejects duplicate topics and constrains memory types, future dates and record capacity
private creative memory filters media, paused, expired and decayed records and makes specific media override general topics
private creative memory selects at most eight records and bounds total selected text without silently slicing content
private creative memory prioritizes active temporary requirements and recent preferences ahead of profile under a limited context budget
private creative memory rejects duplicate Unicode-case topics consistently with resolution
private creative memory resolves legacy Unicode-case duplicates once without deleting either stored record
reusable products enforces private visibility, workspace ownership and read-only members
reusable products prevents a shared product from exposing a private, deleted or inaccessible brand
reusable products uses versions on update, delete and restore, and retains expired records for management
reusable products validates media and brand links again on restore and rejects duplicate or excessive assets
recycled product repair repairs invalid associations while retaining deleted state before explicit restore
knowledge HTTP contracts returns an explicit permission error when another member tries to make a shared product private
knowledge HTTP contracts preserves omitted memory fields on PATCH and applies explicit nulls and kind changes safely
knowledge HTTP contracts preserves product associations and facts when PATCH changes only its name
knowledge HTTP contracts provides current authorized records for conflict review without exposing another user private memory
knowledge HTTP contracts returns computed memory fields, rejects malformed bodies and exposes conflicts as 409
knowledge HTTP contracts requires sessions, denies API keys for memory and preserves product response fields
